name: Lebron
description: Lebron is a gray‑mottled mouse with tiny ears that twitch at the slightest sound. Born under the Moon, he drifts through life with a dreamy, forgetful disposition, often lost in thoughts of distant starry nights. Despite his absent‑minded ways, Lebron is a diligent ale brewer, tending a tiny tankard, a sack of malt, and a well‑worn brewing apron that have been passed down through his family. He loves the warm hiss of boiling wort and the camaraderie of a good tavern, though he sometimes forgets where he left his tools. Quick‑on‑his‑feet (DEX 9) and sturdy (STR 10), Lebron is ready to sip adventure and brew a legend of his own.
